[{"id":11137278574929,"title":"Clever Soup Maker","handle":"drew-cole-clever-soup","description":"

Say goodbye to stirring, simmering, separate blending and a sink full of washing up! Drew&Cole Clever Soup Maker cooks and blends in one clever appliance, making fresh homemade soup as simple as adding your ingredients, choosing a program and pressing start.

  • Soups, sauces, milks, milkshakes, dressings, smoothies, dips, purées and more: Your complete all-in-one kitchen assistant for making homemade favourites from scratch.

  • Bottom-Mounted Integrated VortexBlade System for Superior Performance: Unlike traditional soup makers with blades suspended from the lid, Clever Soup’s blade is built right into the base of the jug. As it blends, it creates a powerful vortex that continuously draws your ingredients down and through the cutting zone, helping everything blend together for deliciously smooth, consistent results.

  • All-in-one cook and blend design: Cooks and blends in the same jug, saving time, effort and washing up with no separate saucepan or blender required.

  • Flexible portion sizes: With a minimum fill level of 0.6L, you can prepare smaller batches, perfect for cooking for one or two. Need bigger portions? Fill up to 1L for hot ingredients or 1.2L for cold ingredients.

  • Smooth Soup program: Automatically cooks and blends your ingredients into deliciously smooth, velvety homemade soup at the touch of a button.

  • Chunky Soup program: Creates hearty, textured soups with visible pieces of your favourite ingredients for that comforting, traditional homemade taste.

  • Smooth+ pulse control: Blend for anywhere from 2 seconds to 1 minute, giving you extra control to make your soup as smooth or textured as you like.

  • Clever Memory function: Remove the lid mid-cycle and for up to two minutes Clever Soup remembers where it stopped, letting you taste test or even add delicate herbs, pasta or noodles towards the end of the cooking cycle before continuing the program.

  • Know what goes into every bowl: Choose your own fresh ingredients, flavours and seasoning, making it easy to add more vegetables, reduce salt or create recipes exactly your way.

  • Make the most of leftovers: Turn those last carrots, potatoes, onions and other leftover vegetables into delicious homemade soup, helping reduce food waste and make ingredients go further.

  • Oat/Nut Milk program: Make fresh oat or nut milk alternatives at home using ingredients you choose, giving Clever Soup even more everyday versatility.

  • Hot and cold programs – use it all year: Go beyond warming winter soups with cold blending for chilled recipes, sauces, dressings and more, making Clever Soup useful throughout the year.

  • Automatic Keep Warm function: Keeps your freshly made soup warm after cooking, so it's ready to serve when you are, even when life gets in the way.

  • Auto Clean programme and BONUS cleaning brush: Clean up is a breeze. Use the autoclean function to loosen residue left behind after cooking and blending, then use the included cleaning brush to take care of the rest.

  • Double-wall jug: Helps your freshly made soup stay warmer while helping the outside of the jug remain cooler.

  • Feed the family for less: The 35-minute Smooth and Chunky Soup programs cost pennies in electricity to run, helping make fresh homemade meals great value.*

*Based on the 35-minute Smooth/Chunky Soup program using the 800W heating function at 24.67p/kWh. Excludes ingredient costs. Actual cost may vary by tariff, program, fill level and ingredients.

Say goodbye to stirring, simmering, separate blending and a sink full of washing up! Drew&Cole Clever Soup Maker cooks and blends in one clever appliance, making fresh homemade soup as simple as adding your ingredients, choosing a program and pressing start.

  • Soups, sauces, milks, milkshakes, dressings, smoothies, dips, purées and more: Your complete all-in-one kitchen assistant for making homemade favourites from scratch.

  • Bottom-Mounted Integrated VortexBlade System for Superior Performance: Unlike traditional soup makers with blades suspended from the lid, Clever Soup’s blade is built right into the base of the jug. As it blends, it creates a powerful vortex that continuously draws your ingredients down and through the cutting zone, helping everything blend together for deliciously smooth, consistent results.

  • All-in-one cook and blend design: Cooks and blends in the same jug, saving time, effort and washing up with no separate saucepan or blender required.

  • Flexible portion sizes: With a minimum fill level of 0.6L, you can prepare smaller batches, perfect for cooking for one or two. Need bigger portions? Fill up to 1L for hot ingredients or 1.2L for cold ingredients.

  • Smooth Soup program: Automatically cooks and blends your ingredients into deliciously smooth, velvety homemade soup at the touch of a button.

  • Chunky Soup program: Creates hearty, textured soups with visible pieces of your favourite ingredients for that comforting, traditional homemade taste.

  • Smooth+ pulse control: Blend for anywhere from 2 seconds to 1 minute, giving you extra control to make your soup as smooth or textured as you like.

  • Clever Memory function: Remove the lid mid-cycle and for up to two minutes Clever Soup remembers where it stopped, letting you taste test or even add delicate herbs, pasta or noodles towards the end of the cooking cycle before continuing the program.

  • Know what goes into every bowl: Choose your own fresh ingredients, flavours and seasoning, making it easy to add more vegetables, reduce salt or create recipes exactly your way.

  • Make the most of leftovers: Turn those last carrots, potatoes, onions and other leftover vegetables into delicious homemade soup, helping reduce food waste and make ingredients go further.

  • Oat/Nut Milk program: Make fresh oat or nut milk alternatives at home using ingredients you choose, giving Clever Soup even more everyday versatility.

  • Hot and cold programs – use it all year: Go beyond warming winter soups with cold blending for chilled recipes, sauces, dressings and more, making Clever Soup useful throughout the year.

  • Automatic Keep Warm function: Keeps your freshly made soup warm after cooking, so it's ready to serve when you are, even when life gets in the way.

  • Auto Clean programme and BONUS cleaning brush: Clean up is a breeze. Use the autoclean function to loosen residue left behind after cooking and blending, then use the included cleaning brush to take care of the rest.

  • Double-wall jug: Helps your freshly made soup stay warmer while helping the outside of the jug remain cooler.

  • Feed the family for less: The 35-minute Smooth and Chunky Soup programs cost pennies in electricity to run, helping make fresh homemade meals great value.*

*Based on the 35-minute Smooth/Chunky Soup program using the 800W heating function at 24.67p/kWh. Excludes ingredient costs. Actual cost may vary by tariff, program, fill level and ingredients.

Worried about condensation, musty odours, and excess moisture in your home? SmartAir Dehumidifer is the dehumidifier that removes up to 20L of damp, mould and moisture from the air daily, is energy-efficient and comes packed with features. It’ll even help you dry your clothes faster!

  • Removes up to 20L of moisture per day: Dehumidifier’s powerful, rapid extraction lowers humidity levels, helping prevent mould, mildew, and condensation in your home.
  • Prevents Mould and Mildew: removing moisture from the air in your home helps you stop mould and mildew from taking hold in damp areas.
  • Costs just 11p an hour to run!
  • Dry your laundry quicker, easier and cheaper: Dehumidifier’s laundry mode runs continuously at a high speed to remove moisture from the air quickly, so your clothes will dry faster – and it costs less to run than a tumble dryer!
    • Features 5 modes:
      • Normal Mode is simple and cost-effective. Select a target humidity and Dehumidifier will run until the room reaches your desired humidity, then it shuts off on its own.
      • Continuous Mode is perfect for rooms with a lot of excess moisture. Dehumidifier will run continually, constantly removing moisture from the air with a fixed low-speed fan.
      • Strong Mode is ideal for rapid dehumidifying – it removes moisture from the air until your room reaches 30% humidity with a fixed high-speed fan.
      • Laundry Mode is the money-saving alternative to tumble drying! A fixed high-speed fan rapidly pulls the moisture in from your room helping your clothes dry faster – it also prevents rooms from retaining the moisture emitted from the laundry!
      • Sleep Mode runs alongside any of the other four modes, all lights on your Dehumidifier will turn off so you’ll get a restful sleep while the bedroom air maintains a perfectly balanced humidity level.
  • Take the chill out of any room: make any room feel warmer in minutes by removing the excess humidity.
  • Protects your home, furniture and belongings: removing and preventing excess moisture in your home shields your furniture, electronics, and clothing from damage.
  • Creates healthier indoor air quality: dehumidifying the air in your home prevents mould spores from growing – breathe easy with Dehumidifier!
  • Eliminates Musty Odors: reduce the humidity levels that cause stale, unpleasant smells, leaving your home smelling fresh!
  • Intelligent humidity sensor: you can trust SmartAir. Dehumidifier monitors room humidity and updates the easy-read LED display so you can rest easy knowing your home is protected from excess moisture.
  • Large 5.5L water tank: perfect for larger spaces and extended use without frequent emptying.
  • Optional continuous drainage hose: includes a 1m hose for uninterrupted operation, ideal for long-term use.
  • 24-Hour delay timer: program the dehumidifier to start or stop exactly when you need it, you’re in complete control.
  • Sleep mode: disables display lights while maintaining full functionality for peaceful, nighttime operation.
  • Portable design: the compact, space-saving build features four castor wheels and two carry handles for easy movement between rooms. Take Dehumidifier where you need it!
